title: Moya calligraphy blind-eval sample manifest (single sample, non-identifying metadata only)
description: MN-EVAL-02: one JSON object per sample. Only randomized sample id, copybook/task version, media type, consent status and non-identifying media metadata. MUST NOT contain child names, WeChat ids, contact info, openids, AppIDs, tokens or URLs.

sample_id.description: Randomly assigned opaque sample id (S01..S20). Assignment is random and must not encode or correlate with any real-world identity.

copybook_version.description: Copybook (字帖) version identifier, synthetic value only.

task_version.description: Task (作业任务) version identifier, synthetic value only.

media_type.description: Submission media type for arm A input.

consent_status.description: Guardian consent state for this sample. revoked samples MUST be excluded from the blind eval (see protocol.md exit rules).

consent_scope.description: Consent scope is strictly the offline blind evaluation; no training, no cross-org reuse.

deidentification.description: Confirms the media and manifest have been de-identified before entering the eval set.

submission_month.description: Coarse (month-precision) submission period; exact timestamps are intentionally not recorded.

media_duration_seconds.description: Required when media_type=video: total practice video duration in seconds (synthetic value in fixtures).

media_image_count.description: Required when media_type=image: number of finished-work photos (synthetic value in fixtures).

process_frames_selected.description: Number of manually pre-selected process frames for arm B input. 0 = arm B uses finished image only; 3-5 = arm B adds process frames.

then.$comment: revoked consent must never enter the eval set
